notes.title: 🌿 Chapter 1: The Journey Begins
notes.notes:
[p]🆕 [b]Additions[/b][/p][p][b]Prologue & Story Foundation[/b]
The game now begins with a [b]new prologue[/b] introducing the creation of the world and setting the stage for your adventure.
Throughout Chapter 1, you’ll encounter [b]new characters[/b] — some who will guide you, and others who will test your strength.[/p][p][b]Challenge Mode[/b]
A brand-new [b]Challenge Mode[/b] has been added! Build a deck from cards you’ve unlocked during the Catalyst Trials and face off against key characters. Winning these battles will allow you to progress further and unlock rewards.[/p][p][b]First Keeper: Rosethorn[/b]
Rosethorn, the [b]Keeper of Nature[/b], makes her debut as the first major trial of Chapter 1. Her opening battle is meant to give you a taste of what’s ahead, with bigger challenges waiting as the story unfolds.[/p][p][b]New Artifacts[/b]
A variety of new [b]artifacts[/b] have been introduced to diversify strategies and create new deck synergies.[/p][hr][/hr][p]⚙️ [b]Tweaks & Improvements[/b][/p][p][b]Catalyst Trials Progression[/b][/p][list][*][p]Trials now scale in difficulty as you advance, with enemy decks evolving along the way.[/p][/*][*][p]Higher card rarities are unlocked in later trial runs, rewarding progression.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Merchant Rework[/b][/p][list][*][p]Prices and drop weights have been adjusted to better reflect card rarity and player progression.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Balance Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Multiple [b]commanders and cards[/b] have been rebalanced for smoother gameplay across the new chapter.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Visual & Usability Enhancements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Numerous visual improvements throughout the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Continued work on Chapter 1 side quests and events (coming in future updates).[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]🐞 [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed multiple gameplay and visual bugs to improve overall stability.[/p][/*][*][p]Polished artifact interactions and card effects.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v0.5: 🔥💧 Elemental Awakening Update
notes.notes:
[p]🆕 [b]Additions[/b][/p][p][b]New Elements: Fire & Water[/b]
Two new elemental affinities have entered the battlefield! Fire brings aggressive plays and explosive tempo, while Water offers fluid repositioning and clever control.
Many older [b]Neutral cards have been reassigned[/b] to better match these elemental identities — expect familiar faces with refined roles.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Keywords[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Combo[/b] – Play cards in succession and hit combo thresholds for bonus effects.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rush[/b] – Can attack other units when played.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Vulnerable[/b] – A new debuff that makes the card take bonus damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]On Move[/b] – Effects that trigger when repositioning.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Elemental Counters[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Water Counters[/b] allow bonus movement — spend 1 counter for each extra zone moved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fire Counters[/b] deal [b]1 non-combat damage[/b] per counter on a stack at the start of its turn.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]World Map & Practice Mode[/b][/p][list][*][p]New nodes added: [b]Karghan Stadium[/b] (Practice Mode) and [b]Nexus of Creation[/b] (Challenges coming soon).[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]⚙️ [b]Tweaks & Improvements[/b][/p][p][b]Adventure Map Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Map now pans automatically on Round 1 and auto locates on your current position in later rounds.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Combat Keyword Rework[/b][/p][list][*][p]We’ve removed [b]Ambush[/b], [b]First Strike[/b], and [b]Duelist[/b]. These priority abilities made board presence too overwhelming and reduced comeback potential.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Ranged[/b] has been reworked to simplify its role — it now [b]blocks Flying[/b] units and [b]deals bonus damage[/b] when doing so. This helps balance its impact whether you're ahead or behind on the board.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Card Identity & Behavior Updates[/b][/p][list][*][p]Items and enchantments now correctly apply effects to the [b]top of a card stack[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Stat boosts and keywords now target the correct unit in a stack.[/p][/*][*][p]Numerous [b]Neutral cards have been reworked[/b] or reassigned.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Balance Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Most cards have been reviewed and rebalanced to account for the new elements and gameplay changes.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Interface & Usability[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated card inspector logic for better keyword visibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Main menu now asks for confirmation before exiting.[/p][/*][*][p]Older saves are now checked and reset for compatibility.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]🐞 [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed hover box issues on hand cards.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various issues with “When Played” triggers on items/enchantments.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed alternate art cards appearing at the merchant.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various text and keyword display bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Backend fixes for damage resolution and death triggers.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v0.4.7: New Events, AI Decks & Card Fixes!
notes.notes:
[h2]🆕 Additions[/h2][list][*][p][b]New Events![/b]
A variety of new events have been added, each featuring custom backgrounds, characters, and dialogue with impactful choices. Events adapt based on your current run progress for a dynamic experience every time.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New AI Decks[/b]
Enemy decks for [b]Plants, Healing Beasts, Angels[/b], and [b]Knights[/b] have been added to keep the challenge fresh.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Card Collection Updates[/b]
Cards bought from the merchant now get added to your collection.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Audio[/b]
Rest nodes now have audio feedback.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]⚙️ Tweaks & Improvements[/h2][list][*][p][b]Card Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Terracotta Rex[/i], [i]Gaihydra[/i] updated[/p][/*][*][p][i]Siliskar[/i] has returned[/p][/*][*][p]Some light cards have been[i] [/i]slightly nerfed[/p][/*][*][p]Commanders with Ranged were a bit strong, especially on the Wizard who could boost itself. We have removed Ranged on some Neutral commanders in accordance.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]AI Deck Balancing[/b]
Older enemy decks received some fine-tuning for improved variety and balance.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed various audio-related issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [i]various[/i] cards not matching their description[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Some of the new cards and changes applied:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45675481/2de3ee3cd6c9ffa2ff1879689989b914c45a82d2.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45675481/346d0cab0a102278ef2856e6d6dc407a1c592d54.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45675481/a32e4c69a4775683a33d2ef16d6add5bdae42c90.png"][/img][/p]
